response.sql: WITH status_shares AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM status_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.share) AS average_excess_share FROM status_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.share;

assumptions.assumption: Shares are expressed as fractions of all telescopes, from 0 to 1.
